# Copilot Instructions — userscripts

## Repository layout

| Path                                                                         | Purpose                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `autotask/`, `chatgpt/`, `cloudradial/`, `general/`, `microsoft/`, `search/` | **Source** userscripts — edit these                   |
| `_dist/`                                                                     | **Built** artifacts — **never edit**; generated by CI |
| `_tools/build-userscripts.mjs`                                               | Build script that produces `_dist/`                   |
| `_tools/lint.mjs`                                                            | Linter script for checking code quality               |
| `_templates/`                                                                | Starter template for new scripts                      |

## Versioning — date-based, per-script, fully automatic

- **Do not** manually change `@version` in source scripts.
  Versions are determined automatically by the build script using date-based
  format `YYYY.MMDD.HHMM` (e.g. `2026.0420.2150`).
- Each script has its own version — only bumped when that script's content changes.
- The `version` field in `package.json` is the **repo** version (managed by
  semantic-release) and is separate from individual script versions.

## Conventional Commits

Every commit that should trigger a release **must** use a [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) prefix:

| Prefix                                                   | Effect                          |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `fix:`                                                   | Patch bump (e.g. 3.0.0 → 3.0.1) |
| `feat:`                                                  | Minor bump (e.g. 3.0.1 → 3.1.0) |
| `feat!:` or body contains `BREAKING CHANGE:`             | Major bump (e.g. 3.1.0 → 4.0.0) |
| `chore:`, `docs:`, `style:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:` | No release                      |

## Build & dist

- `node _tools/build-userscripts.mjs` generates `_dist/*.user.js` (full script) and `_dist/*.meta.js` (metadata-only, for lightweight update checks).
- The build compares each source script against its existing `_dist/` output.
  Only scripts whose content actually changed get a new date-based version.
  Unchanged scripts keep their existing `_dist/` version and are not re-committed.
- CI runs the build automatically on every release via GitHub Actions.

## Adding a new script

1. Create the `.user.js` file in the appropriate category directory.
2. Copy the header from `_templates/userscript-template.user.js`.
3. Set `@updateURL` to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warthurton/userscripts/main/_dist/<name>.meta.js`
4. Set `@downloadURL` to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warthurton/userscripts/main/_dist/<name>.user.js`
5. Commit with a conventional commit message (e.g. `feat: add new-script`).
6. CI will build the dist artifacts and publish a release.

## Rules for AI agents / code generation

- **Never** edit files under `_dist/`.
- **Never** change `@version` in source headers for release purposes.
- **Never** edit the `version` field in `package.json`.
- Source scripts may have any `@version` value; the build script replaces it.
- Use conventional commit messages so semantic-release can determine the next version.
- When generating a new userscript, follow the template and point update/download URLs to `_dist/`.
